findingDetails.title: Same-class inventory incomplete: three live docs still state a hub ROUTER.md carries the SKILL.md/release version
findingDetails.case: An agent runs the /create:changelog skill for a hub release and follows the live SKILL.md instructions, which still name ROUTER.md among the version carriers to set to next_version; ROUTER.md is overwritten with the release version, recreating the exact drift the phase removes, and sk-doc's own SKILL.md still tells hub authors that ROUTER.md carries the release value.
findingDetails.evidence: sk-create-changelog/SKILL.md:261 step 6 says 'set next_version in every version carrier the component's skill root already has (SKILL.md, ROUTER.md, description.json, hub-router.json and mode-registry.json, never README.md)'. sk-doc/SKILL.md:17 says 'description.json, mode-registry.json, hub-router.json, and ROUTER.md carry the same value, so every hub-root artifact states the same release'. examples-and-maintenance.md:181 says the changelog sets the new version in 'SKILL.md, and for a hub ROUTER.md, description.json, hub-router.json and mode-registry.json' and that the doctor 'then confirms every copy matches'. All three contradict the reviewed change (frontmatter-versioning.md:124: 'A hub ROUTER.md is not a release copy ... no gate compares it with SKILL.md') and VP-3. implementation-summary.md records no inventory entry, and tasks.md T002 and CHK-FIX-002 remain unchecked.
findingDetails.userImpact: Release operators following the skill instructions silently discard a hub ROUTER.md's own edition and restore release-version coupling; hub authors are told the doctor enforces a parity that no longer exists, so the phase's purpose is undercut by the docs that drive its own workflow.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep -rn 'ROUTER.md' over .skilled/commands and .skilled/skills/sk-doc (excluding node_modules and changelog/) paired with version context returned exactly these three live claims; the remaining ROUTER.md-version hits are format-only (parent-skill-root-router-template.md:29, create-skill-parent-*.yaml) and consistent with own-edition, and sk-doc/sk-create-changelog/changelog/v1.3.4.0.md:24 is a historical entry left as history.
findingDetails.recommendation: Complete the spec's same-class inventory: correct the three sites (drop ROUTER.md from the version-carrier list, restate that it keeps its own edition), or record each with an explicit reason in tasks.md/implementation-summary.md; add a README-style 'ROUTER.md is not a version carrier' note to the twins' version-copy activity so the omission is deliberate.
findingDetails.claim: Three live, committed documents still assert a hub ROUTER.md carries the SKILL.md/release version, and one of them instructs the release workflow to write it, contradicting VP-3/REQ-003 and the phase's own inventory deliverable.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched implementation-summary.md for any inventory/claim record (none), searched all of .skilled/commands and .skilled/skills/sk-doc for corrected or listed variants, and checked whether the three lines sit in historical changelog entries rather than live docs (they are live files at HEAD 95698b591b, confirmed via git show).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The build may have scoped the inventory to the files it edited, treating pre-existing sk-doc hub prose as out of phase scope; or the operators may consider the standard (frontmatter-versioning.md) authoritative over tool-facing skill docs. Neither substitutes for the spec's explicit 'corrected or listed with its reason' wording, and the changelog SKILL.md line directly conflicts with the YAML twins changed in the same commit.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If implementation-summary.md or tasks.md is updated to list these three sites with a recorded reason, or a follow-up commit corrects them, downgrade to P2/resolved; the finding resolves fully when all three agree with frontmatter-versioning.md:124.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Five-file tooling, workflow and documentation change with a cross-consumer documentation surface; not trivial and not repo-wide complex.

targetSelection.selectionReason: The five diff scope files plus every live claim located by exact search for hub ROUTER.md version parity, because the spec's same-class inventory deliverable binds the change to those claims.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The new test's String.replace could no-op if the fixture did not contain the version line, making its assertions vacuous.

searchActions.result: stage1Router() emits 'version: ${VERSION}' in frontmatter; the first-occurrence replace mutates ROUTER.md to 1.0.0.9, and the test then asserts no 13a FAIL and a 13a PASS line.

searchLedger.rationale: The fixture contains the replaced string, so the mutation is effective and the test is live.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: fixture emits the replaced version line; replace is effective

searchLedger.hypothesis: Removing ROUTER.md from the follower list could accidentally weaken the JSON parity checks or their failure path.

searchActions.result: description.json, hub-router.json and mode-registry.json remain followers; non-four-part values and mismatches both softFail; pass message updated to JSON-only wording.
Existing case still pins a differing description.json to a 13a FAIL (lines 406 and 515).

searchLedger.rationale: The JSON follower set and both failure branches are unchanged and still covered.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: direct read shows JSON followers retained with mismatch and format softFails

searchLedger.invariant: Every live claim that a hub ROUTER.md carries the SKILL.md version is corrected or listed with its reason (spec scope bullet, tasks.md T002, CHK-FIX-002).

searchActions.queryOrPath: grep -rn 'ROUTER.md' with version context over .skilled/commands and .skilled/skills/sk-doc, excluding node_modules and changelog/
searchActions.result: Three live claims remain uncorrected: sk-doc/SKILL.md:17, sk-create-changelog/SKILL.md:261, examples-and-maintenance.md:181.
implementation-summary.md records no inventory entry; tasks.md T002 and CHK-FIX-002 remain unchecked.

searchLedger.rationale: The claims contradict the post-change behavior and the spec's inventory deliverable.

searchLedger.invariant: Narrowing a version-metadata comparison must not remove a security-relevant guard.

searchActions.result: The function performs string equality and JSON.parse-backed version reads only; no auth, injection, secret-handling or destructive side-effect surface.

searchLedger.rationale: Version metadata comparison has no security surface; the diff touches no runtime enforcement path.
searchLedger.notApplicableReason: no security-relevant guard removed; version strings are non-executable metadata

searchLedger.hypothesis: Dropping the ROUTER.md line without a README-style 'not a version carrier' note invites re-addition.

searchActions.result: Twins remain aligned; the README note is retained; ROUTER.md is now absent with no explanatory note.

searchLedger.rationale: Spec VP-3 asks only to drop the line and C4 installs a smallest-change rule; the durable fix for the ambiguity is correcting the three live docs (R1-P1-001).
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no defect in the changed files; spec-scoped minimal change, addressed by the R1-P1-001 recommendation

searchLedger.hypothesis: REQ-005 (six hubs pass the doctor) relies on the goal's command runs, which this iteration did not execute.

searchActions.result: No acceptance command was executed in this read-only review iteration; hub pass status is asserted by the goal baseline only.

searchLedger.rationale: Review iterations are read-only against the target; executing the acceptance commands belongs to the build's closure gate.
searchLedger.deferredReason: not executed in read-only review; residual validation gap for the closure gate

searchLedger.hypothesis: The two YAML twins could drift while dropping the ROUTER.md line.

searchActions.queryOrPath: diff of both twins around the version-copy activity
searchActions.result: Both files carry the identical removal and identical surrounding lines; no other ROUTER.md reference remains in either twin.

searchLedger.rationale: The twins are byte-consistent in the changed activity.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: direct diff shows identical removals and aligned lists
